name: SELECT, aliases, filters, ordering and LIMIT
note: Core query binding and execution exist.
acceptance: Compare ordering/ties, aliases, NULL ordering, LIMIT/OFFSET and errors across literals and stored data.

name: INNER/LEFT/RIGHT/CROSS and nested joins
note: Core joins exist; nested RIGHT and some grouped shapes remain restricted.
acceptance: Differential cases for USING/NATURAL, null extension, multi-key, theta, nested and bushy joins; repeat with spill.

name: Correlated scalar, IN and EXISTS subqueries
note: Decorrelation and bounded dependent execution exist; wider forms are restricted.
acceptance: Check empty/multi-row results, NULL-sensitive NOT IN, depth, alias scoping, memory ceilings and planner alternatives.

name: UNION, INTERSECT and EXCEPT
note: ALL/DISTINCT, precedence and operand scoping are implemented.
acceptance: Compare bag multiplicities, output coercion/collation, branch LIMIT and spill; verify 8.0 patch-specific availability.

name: Nonrecursive CTEs and derived tables
note: CTE and derived-table bindings exist.
acceptance: Check name shadowing, reuse, nested scope, projection names/types and materialization.

name: Recursive CTEs
note: Canonical one-member fixpoints are supported with a bounded recursion setting.
acceptance: Compare UNION/UNION ALL, anchor types, recursion limits, duplicate elimination, unsupported recursion shapes and errors.

name: LATERAL derived tables
note: Derived-table binding explicitly rejects lateral=true.
acceptance: Add dependent table evaluation and compare correlation scope, joins and empty results.

name: GROUP BY, HAVING and functional dependence
note: Grouping works; dependence through additional UNIQUE indexes remains limited.
acceptance: Compare ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY, composite keys, NULL-able UNIQUE keys, aliases, HAVING and error codes.

name: ROLLUP and GROUPING
note: Keyword inventories do not establish subtotal/grouping-indicator execution.
acceptance: Exercise WITH ROLLUP, genuine NULL versus subtotal NULL, HAVING and ORDER BY; then classify support.

name: Window functions, frames and named windows
note: Several windows and ROWS/RANGE frames exist; function/argument/frame restrictions remain.
acceptance: Check peer groups, frame bounds, named inheritance, empty frames, null treatment and memory limits.

name: JSON_TABLE relational expansion
note: No supported JSON_TABLE table-factor route.
acceptance: Implement ordinality, nested paths, ON EMPTY/ERROR, coercion and implicit lateral semantics.

name: Views and view security semantics
note: A VIEWS discovery relation does not prove CREATE VIEW or executable stored views.
acceptance: Check source-view discovery/replication and local view DDL, resolution, definer/invoker and check-option semantics separately.

name: Optimizer hints and EXPLAIN
note: Pintail exposes its own optimizer/explain behavior; output is not assumed MySQL-identical.
acceptance: Inventory accepted/ignored/rejected hints; compare query results with hints and document EXPLAIN contract.

name: Full-text MATCH AGAINST
note: No full-text execution/index support established.
acceptance: Compare natural-language/boolean modes, stopwords, tokenization, ranking, collation and index errors.

name: Spatial queries and indexes
note: Spatial querying is outside current scope; binary retention does not establish GIS semantics.
acceptance: Keep explicit rejection; require owner scope change before GIS implementation.

name: TABLE, VALUES and locking SELECT forms
note: Parser keywords alone do not establish executable statement forms.
acceptance: Probe TABLE/VALUES, INTO OUTFILE, FOR UPDATE/SHARE, NOWAIT/SKIP LOCKED and document each contract.

name: Signed/unsigned integer ranges and BIT
note: Pintail has native integer carriers including UInt64.
acceptance: Compare every width and signedness, BIT lengths, overflow and text/binary wire flags.

name: DECIMAL precision, arithmetic and display
note: Exact scaled arithmetic exists; precision above 38 becomes text and display/metadata residuals remain.
acceptance: Check precision 1..65, scale, chained arithmetic, grouping, rounding, overflow and per-value result formatting.

name: FLOAT/DOUBLE and numeric coercion
note: Approximate execution exists; broad conversion/diagnostic parity is not certified.
acceptance: Compare exponent literals, overflow/underflow, domain errors, mixed text/numeric comparison and metadata.

name: DATE/DATETIME/TIMESTAMP/TIME/YEAR
note: Temporal carriers and functions exist with documented zero-date, TIME and parsing restrictions.
acceptance: Check negative/extended TIME, zero/partial dates, all fractional precisions, epoch limits and snapshot/CDC equivalence.

name: Time zones and statement time
note: Wire session zone and pinned statement time exist; HTTP/session and stored-value effects differ.
acceptance: Test DST gaps/folds, named/fixed zones, statement stability and prepared execution.

name: Character sets and transcoding
note: Supported source encodings are bounded; query transcoding is narrower.
acceptance: Compare utf8mb4/utf8mb3/ascii/latin1 bytes and invalid sequences; reject unsupported encodings before serving wrong text.

name: Collation weights, padding and coercibility
note: Three compatibility profiles exist; aliases/non-ASCII weights and mixed coercibility are restricted.
acceptance: Compare equality/order/hash/group/join/LIKE, PAD/NO PAD, explicit COLLATE and mixed profiles through every storage path.

name: BINARY/VARBINARY/BLOB and TEXT lengths
note: Binary carriers work; variable-expression metadata uses fallback widths.
acceptance: Check embedded NUL, trailing spaces, bytes versus characters, source declaration lengths and binary/text protocol.

name: ENUM and SET identity
note: Declaration ordinal/mask and string-comparison behavior exist with residual coercion/collation limits.
acceptance: Compare numeric/string contexts, invalid/empty members, schema history, ordering, grouping and CDC updates.

name: JSON identity, comparison and typed members
note: JSON ordering and identity exist; typed members, mixed comparison and several key contexts remain restricted.
acceptance: Compare JSON versus text/null, duplicate keys, numeric scale, temporal members, binary encoding and metadata.

name: JSON paths, mutation and schema validation
note: Many read/search/mutation functions exist; schema validation and other family members are gaps.
acceptance: Use the per-function ledger; cover wildcards, recursive paths, last/ranges, autowrap and invalid paths.

name: SQL modes, escaping and parser behavior
note: Modes that alter parsing/evaluation are explicitly rejected; selected inert modes are retained.
acceptance: Compare mode combinations, quotes/escapes, operator precedence and connection reset; never treat accepted-but-ignored behavior as parity.

name: Identifiers, case and reserved words
note: Catalog resolution and advertised lower_case_table_names use a Pintail-specific contract.
acceptance: Check quoted/unquoted Unicode identifiers, case modes, reserved/function names, IGNORE_SPACE and length limits.

name: NULL and three-valued logic
note: Core NULL predicates and expression evaluation exist.
acceptance: Truth-table tests for all predicates, null-safe equality, CASE/IF short circuit, IN/NOT IN and aggregates.

name: Errors, warnings and diagnostics area
note: Selected MySQL error mappings and GROUP_CONCAT warnings exist; general diagnostics do not.
acceptance: Compare errno, SQLSTATE, message category, warning count, SHOW WARNINGS and diagnostics lifetime.

name: Generated and invisible columns
note: Stored generated values are mirrored; virtual columns are skipped.
acceptance: Check generated expressions, invisible/GIPK discovery, column ordering, source DDL and binlog layouts.

name: Database/table creation
note: Local CREATE TABLE exists; database control-plane creation is distinct from SQL DDL parity.
acceptance: Compare CREATE DATABASE/TABLE variants, IF NOT EXISTS, type options, duplicate objects and crash-safe publication.

name: INSERT VALUES
note: Literal INSERT exists with primary-key/NULL checks; expression values are rejected.
acceptance: Compare omitted columns, multi-row inserts, coercion, errors, atomicity and affected rows.

name: INSERT SELECT, REPLACE and duplicate-key update
note: Current write engine accepts literal inserts, not these extended write forms.
acceptance: Implement and compare conflict handling, unique keys, affected rows and transaction visibility.

name: UPDATE and DELETE
note: Both are explicitly documented as unimplemented.
acceptance: Compare predicates, multi-table forms, ORDER/LIMIT, key changes, atomicity and errors.

name: ALTER/DROP/RENAME/TRUNCATE local tables
note: Local statement dispatch handles CREATE TABLE and INSERT only.
acceptance: Compare DDL validation, metadata publication, concurrent readers and restart recovery.

name: PRIMARY/UNIQUE/FK/CHECK constraints
note: Primary key and NOT NULL checks exist; other accepted constraints are not enforced.
acceptance: Assert invalid rows are refused with MySQL-compatible errors and correct statement rollback.

name: Defaults and AUTO_INCREMENT
note: AUTO_INCREMENT does not allocate; non-NULL defaults are refused.
acceptance: Compare omitted versus NULL values, generated IDs, restart persistence and LAST_INSERT_ID.

name: BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK/SAVEPOINT
note: Local explicit transactions are refused; each supported statement autocommits.
acceptance: Implement atomic multi-statement writes and verify rollback, savepoints, failure recovery and wire status bits.

name: Isolation, MVCC, locks and deadlocks
note: Serialized local writes/read snapshots are not InnoDB transaction isolation.
acceptance: Define supported isolation levels, conflict/deadlock behavior and concurrent read/write tests.

name: Temporary tables and session lifetime
note: Temporary-table grammar acceptance and session isolation need direct review.
acceptance: Check visibility, name shadowing, disconnect/reset cleanup and rollback behavior.

name: XA distributed transactions
note: Not established and beyond current autocommit implementation; scope needs a decision.
acceptance: Decide whether explicit rejection is the contract; if required, test prepare/commit/recovery.

name: Stored procedures/functions, triggers and events
note: Replica stored procedures/triggers are excluded by v1 scope; local programmability needs a separate decision.
acceptance: Keep source-executed row effects correct via CDC; do not imply local routine execution.

name: LOAD DATA and import/export statements
note: No full SQL bulk-loader compatibility claim follows from Pintail snapshot loading.
acceptance: Probe LOAD DATA LOCAL/INFILE, character sets, escaping, duplicate handling and file privileges.

name: Writes to mirrored databases
note: Mirrored databases intentionally reject writes and never write back to MySQL.
acceptance: Assert every write form rejects consistently on wire/HTTP/prepared paths without source mutation.

name: Handshake and client capabilities
note: Pintail implements a MySQL-compatible endpoint with a bounded capability surface.
acceptance: Inventory every capability bit; test only advertised features including large packets and sequence errors.

name: Text result sets and binary prepared results
note: Both encodings exist with documented metadata residuals.
acceptance: Compare type codes, flags, charset IDs, length, scale, NULL bitmap, empty results, EOF/OK and errors.

name: Prepared statement lifecycle
note: Prepare/execute/close/reset exist; long data is explicitly unsupported.
acceptance: Test parameter types and rebinds, counts, metadata changes, unknown IDs, reset and memory limits.

name: Long parameters and server-side cursors
note: SEND_LONG_DATA is rejected; cursor behavior needs independent classification.
acceptance: Test cursor execute flags, FETCH, reset/close and chunked parameter input; align advertised capabilities.

name: Multi-statements and multiple results
note: Multiple statements in one command are documented as unsupported.
acceptance: Reject unsupported negotiation/forms predictably; test pending-results state and connection recovery.

name: USE, SET and connection reset/change user
note: Database selection and selected session state/reset handlers exist.
acceptance: Compare state across reset, change-user, pooling, time zone, charset, modes and prepared handles.

name: SHOW and INFORMATION_SCHEMA
note: Ten discovery relations and selected query patterns exist.
acceptance: Inventory actual relations/columns and SHOW forms; compare values, permissions, joins, filters and empty schemas.

name: System and user variables
note: Selected @@variables are handled; this is not full sysvar or user-variable semantics.
acceptance: Inventory read/set/global/session/persist behavior, values/defaults, assignment and unknown-variable errors.

name: KILL QUERY, cancellation and timeouts
note: KILL QUERY works; connection termination forms reject.
acceptance: Verify target IDs, interrupted error, per-query cleanup, disconnect cancellation and timeout units.

name: Connector and BI interoperability
note: Wire tests do not certify every driver; DBeaver/Metabase smokes are not automated.
acceptance: Version a driver matrix including mysql CLI, JDBC, Python, Go, Node and BI discovery/prepared/pooling flows.

name: Protocol compression and X Protocol
note: Classic protocol support does not imply compression or X Protocol/Document Store.
acceptance: Audit capability negotiation and explicit unsupported paths; decide whether either is in scope.

name: Consistent snapshot and snapshot-to-binlog handoff
note: Snapshot/resume exists; lock privilege and mixed-time resume limitations are documented.
acceptance: Mutate concurrently during snapshot/resume, verify no gaps/duplicates, checkpoint handoff and privilege failure behavior.

name: ROW event decoding and row images
note: Native row decoding exists; matrix coverage must be tied to actual source configurations.
acceptance: Test FULL/MINIMAL/NOBLOB images, null masks, all column types, checksums, transaction compression and partial JSON events.

name: GTID and file/position checkpoints
note: Both modes exist with finite per-transaction ordinal limits.
acceptance: Compare replay/idempotence, file rotation, GTID gaps, source UUID changes and exact event-count boundaries.

name: Source transaction atomicity and crash replay
note: Do not infer cross-table transaction visibility from individually correct rows/checkpoints.
acceptance: Kill at each WAL/apply/checkpoint boundary; assert committed data, rollback exclusion and documented query visibility.

name: Source DDL and schema history
note: Compatible column/index changes evolve in place; identity/incompatible changes resnapshot or quarantine.
acceptance: ALTER during live/offline intervals; verify old segments, memtables, new events and table/column identity.

name: Keys, keyless rows and invisible primary keys
note: PK/safe UNIQUE strategies exist; keyless mutation coverage depends on resnapshot/reconciliation.
acceptance: Test nullable/composite keys, duplicate rows, GIPK, key strategy changes and deterministic replay.

name: Polling and reconciliation fallback
note: Polling converges on sampled state; intermediate transactions may be missed.
acceptance: Test same-timestamp updates, deletes, cursorless sources, inclusive overlap and full-key reconciliation.

name: Foreign-key cascade and trigger effects
note: Invisible cascade effects require reconciliation and can remain stale until it runs.
acceptance: Compare cascaded delete/update and trigger-generated rows under selected/unselected parent tables.

name: Disconnect, purged binlog and source replacement
note: Recovery/quarantine paths exist; limits must be measured by failure scenario.
acceptance: Exercise retention loss, reconnects, credentials, failover and checkpoint mismatch with state/data assertions.

name: Source database/table lifecycle
note: Table auto-inclusion is bounded; source database drop is surfaced but retained replica freshness can mislead.
acceptance: Test create/drop/rename/recreate and fail-closed freshness labels for orphaned data.

name: 8.0, 8.4 and older/fork source versions
note: This ledger pins 8.4 source. Repository tests include 8.0; older MySQL/MariaDB claims require independent evidence.
acceptance: Pin patch version/digest and configuration per oracle run; classify added/removed functions and event-format differences.

name: Serving downstream MySQL replicas
note: Consuming a source binlog is distinct from publishing a MySQL-compatible binlog.
acceptance: Keep downstream replication outside the single-node mirror contract unless scope changes.

name: Authentication plugins and password exchanges
note: caching_sha2_password exchanges exist; this does not implement the full plugin/account model.
acceptance: Test fast/full/RSA/TLS auth, malformed handshakes, key rotation, native-password version differences and account revocation.

name: Transport TLS and certificate lifecycle
note: Wire TLS exists; certificate rotation needs restart and HTTP expects ingress TLS.
acceptance: Check negotiation, trust/hostname validation, expiration, TLS policy and restart behavior.

name: Users, GRANT/REVOKE, roles and privileges
note: Pintail API keys/auth are not evidence of MySQL object-privilege equivalence.
acceptance: Inventory actual identity/authorization contracts, tenant/db visibility and denial errors; decide scope for MySQL ACLs.

name: Definer/invoker, resource groups and limits
note: Per-query resource limits do not imply MySQL resource groups or definer semantics.
acceptance: Decide scope, then compare privilege checks and executable resource-limit behavior.

name: Keyring, encryption at rest and audit plugins
note: Optional plugin/component products require explicit deployment/module inventories.
acceptance: Record exact edition/build/plugin and compare external security promises; do not infer them from transport TLS.

name: InnoDB/MyISAM/MEMORY/NDB engine compatibility
note: Pintail intentionally owns a columnar format; MySQL physical files and engines are not parity targets.
acceptance: Preserve agreed SQL/data behavior while rejecting misleading engine-specific promises.

name: Secondary/functional/invisible indexes
note: Source indexes inform metadata; local secondary indexes are not enforced/implemented as MySQL indexes.
acceptance: Separate optimizer performance from UNIQUE enforcement; verify accepted DDL does not imply absent guarantees.

name: Partitioned tables and partition DDL
note: Logical row ingestion does not prove partition EXCHANGE/TRUNCATE handling.
acceptance: Test each source partition operation and its binlog visibility/resnapshot behavior; classify local DDL separately.

name: Crash durability, WAL and corruption detection
note: Pintail has its own WAL/storage recovery contract.
acceptance: Failpoint process death and torn/corrupt writes; verify checkpoint durability and explicit corruption failures.

name: Query memory, spill and admission
note: Pintail implements its own bounded execution and spill paths.
acceptance: Verify result equivalence under low memory, cancellation, cleanup and concurrent admission; benchmark separately.

name: Performance Schema, sys and logs
note: Pintail metrics/logs are available; MySQL Performance Schema/sys query compatibility is not established.
acceptance: Inventory required monitoring queries and semantics; map to native metrics or explicitly reject.

name: Backup/restore and incremental chains
note: Pintail backups/restores use their own format and detached restore contract; no automatic retention policy.
acceptance: Restore full/incremental chains, missing ancestors, checksums and crashes; verify source reconnection policy.

name: Point-in-time recovery
note: Removed by explicit owner decision. Do not rebuild as a parity task.
acceptance: Retain exclusion unless the owner explicitly reverses the decision.

name: HA, clustering and automatic failover
note: Single-process analytics tier has no standby/read replica/failover.
acceptance: Document availability boundary; do not conflate durable recovery with high availability.

name: Upgrade/downgrade and format compatibility
note: MySQL and Pintail have different catalog/storage upgrade systems.
acceptance: Version snapshot/catalog/WAL formats; test supported upgrade paths, rollback and incompatible restores.

name: Plugins, components and loadable functions
note: Native-registry inventory is not an exhaustive inventory of runtime-installed functions/components.
acceptance: Capture deployed mysql.func, plugin/component registries and build flags; add only requested module contracts.

name: Enterprise products and external tooling
note: Community source does not define all Enterprise, Router, Shell, Workbench or HeatWave product capabilities.
acceptance: Maintain separate version/edition/product inventories when deployments require those surfaces.

name: Cross-database queries and local/replica joins
note: A query reaches one database; local and replicated data cannot be joined together.
acceptance: Test qualified names, authorization and snapshot consistency before enabling cross-database joins.
